source.title: Track 50 verified UX bug fixes across Score King
source.body:
## Goal

Deliver 50 newly verified, distinct UX bug fixes following the user's autonomous campaign request on 2026-11-04 at 01:01 UTC. Focus on broken or confusing interactions, display defects, inconsistent existing controls and clear design-contract violations. Preserve features, scoring, stored data and the product's Game-Night LARPer identity.

## Counting and delivery

One reproduced root cause counts as one fix, even when shared across many games. Earlier paired fixes and already-assigned moon feedback, meter design alternatives and rich game help do not count. No speculative bugs or feature additions to fill the target. Each accepted defect gets its own focused issue and owning repair session, regression evidence and normal PR/CI/merge/Pages delivery. At most three non-overlapping repairs run concurrently.

## Discovery

Bounded read-only waves cover core navigation/setup/roster/history/stats; preferences and secondary pages; familiar game editors; board/counter editors; and remaining game editors. Discovery reports will be attached here for deduplication before individual bug filing.

## Safety and verification

Use isolated synthetic browser contexts, never the paired game. No credential, registry, workflow, deployment-dispatch, data/schema, sync or rule changes. Current private-package local install failures must remain explicit; unchanged exact-head Actions and build artifacts may supply executable gates and isolated runtime checks without bypassing them. Preserve pending user design decisions.

## Progress

0 / 50 new fixes verified and delivered at campaign initialization. This tracker is not itself a bug fix. Linked fix issues and PRs will provide the authoritative evidence.

**Do not add these candidates to NEW50 or dispatch them as UI-verified fixes.** This wave completed finite source triage and deterministic source-handler replays, not the requested actual-browser scenario matrix. No production changes, individual issues, repair dispatches, dependency restores, or quota padding.

**Revision:** `e71c744b1518e6ec6d90e22a0061936fd7e090a9`; worktree HEAD, origin/main and GitHub main all matched when checked. Clean isolated checkout `jrmoulckers-didactic-spork`. Exact-head successful CI: https://github.com/jrmoulckers/score-king/actions/runs/41750582447 ; unexpired `score-king-web` artifact ID `13285139626`. The artifact was not downloaded because a static build does not supply the missing browser/control. This is provenance evidence, not runtime verification.

### Evidence method and blocker

Read AGENTS, BUG_LOOP, PRODUCT, DESIGN, bounded bug-bash methodology and UX/a11y skills/checklist. Inspected all eight requested editors plus relevant GolfGrid, BagTossRow, race/progress headers and shared Stepper/global styles. Node v24.3.0 executed **functions and one effect body extracted from the current Svelte sources**, with TypeScript syntax stripped using Node's built-in API. Assertions used synthetic in-memory values and no storage or accounts. These replays confirm the handler paths below but do not mount Svelte, exercise DOM events/effects, measure layout, or establish screen-reader behavior.

No browser-control/canvas tool is exposed; repository resolution of `playwright`, `@playwright/test`, and `puppeteer` failed, and Python is unavailable. No dependency restore/retry, registry/config/credential/source-package workaround or new tooling. Never opened the paired canvas, paired game, real account/data, or another session's browser. No server/background process started.

### Reproduction-ready candidates, NOT accepted campaign findings

All severities below are provisional. Likely implementation owner is **@web-engineer**, with @design-engineer coordination only for presentation decisions; keep fixes editor-local, without rules/scoring/schema/sync changes. File/line references are for the SHA above. Browser-enabled QA must reproduce before accepting any candidate.

**W3-C01 - Golf clearing the final grid card leaves the entered score stale (provisional medium).**

- Source: `src\lib\games\golf\GolfGrid.svelte:48-60,67-79`; `src\lib\games\golf\GolfEditor.svelte:64-71,93-95,147-156`.
- Intended browser reproduction: create a synthetic Golf round, open one player's grid, place a single 5, then reopen that cell and choose its clear option. Expected: after an actively edited grid becomes empty, the grid total and the player's hole score/projected total agree at 0. Suspected actual: grid says 0 while the stepper remains 5.
- **Exact source replay observed:** publishing the one-card grid set editor score=5; `setCard(0,null)` followed by the extracted effect with `filled=false, breakdown.total=0` left editor score=5. Boundary `clearAll()` set editor score=0. Cause: `if (filled && t !== prev)` suppresses the empty-grid transition; the editor also intentionally skips grid/score reconciliation while `openGrid[id]` is true.
- Simple holistic direction: distinguish an untouched empty helper (must preserve a manually typed score) from a grid actively cleared back to empty, and publish 0 for the latter. Reuse existing score callback; do not change computeGrid or stored fields. Regression: untouched empty helper preserves a typed 17; clear-last and clear-all agree; matching-column zero, reopen/edit and manual/grid transitions remain consistent. Actual Svelte scheduling/UI is unverified.

**W3-C02 - Undoing an accidental went-out selection discards a previously tallied hand (provisional medium; acceptance requires confirming intended correction behavior).**

- Source: `src\lib\games\uno\UnoEditor.svelte:76-85`; `src\lib\games\unogolf\UnoGolfEditor.svelte:52-62`; related same destructive-selection pattern at `src\lib\games\chickenfoot\ChickenFootEditor.svelte:35-44` (Chicken Foot was inspected, not replayed).
- Intended browser reproduction: enter one player's number total12/action1/wild1, select their Went out/Sank it button, then deselect it or select the correct different player. Expected correction behavior: the unrelated tally entered before the mistaken selection remains recoverable; the selected actual winner still contributes 0 under existing rules. Suspected actual: the original player's controls return with all zeros.
- **Exact source-handler replay observed in both Uno and Uno Golf:** invoking the extracted handler twice ended with `input.out=null` and `{numbers:0,actions:0,wilds:0}`, replacing `{numbers:12,actions:1,wilds:1}`. Selection overwrites the hand; deselection only clears out identity. The replay proves replacement, not that product policy forbids it. Do not call intentional zero scoring itself a defect.
- If accepted, simplest direction: preserve the pre-selection draft tally across mistaken selection corrections without changing the rule that the actual out player scores0, or provide the repository-standard reversible interaction. Boundaries: switch A->B; toggle A twice; edit populated round; explicit clearing must still clear. Group these consumer symptoms as one correction-interaction root, not several quota entries. Do not alter persisted contracts.

**W3-C03 - Skull King bounty chips do not communicate which captures are selected (provisional medium accessibility).**

- Source: `src\lib\games\skullking\SkullKingEditor.svelte:199-224,365-373`.
- Intended browser/AT reproduction: open Bounty and activate Jolly Roger, Mermaid nabs Skull King, or Skull King eats Mermaid; inspect each control's accessibility state and identify selections without hue. Expected: each control exposes selected/pressed state plus a non-color visual cue. Source actual: each uses `class:on={...}`; selected styling changes color/background, but the button text has no selected marker and none has `aria-pressed`/checked state. Aggregate bounty points cannot identify which capture is selected.
- **Static assertion:** all three matching chip buttons lack pressed/checked state. No screen-reader run or screenshot is claimed. Relevant checks: WCAG1.4.1 and4.1.2.
- Direction: bind native toggle-button `aria-pressed` and a visible check/selected cue to each existing boolean; keep captures, points, bounty disclosure and scoring unchanged. Boundary: multiple simultaneous captures, keyboard toggle on/off, and populated edit mode. One root across three chips.

**W3-C04 - Cornhole side palette has indistinguishable options and no semantic selection (provisional medium accessibility).**

- Source: `src\lib\games\cornhole\CornholeEditor.svelte:305-316,657-668`.
- Intended browser/AT reproduction: open Sides, keyboard-focus several palette options and select a color, then revisit it. Expected: options have distinct meaningful names, expose selection, and meet the repository46px interaction target. Source actual: all options are labelled only `Set side colour`, omit pressed/checked state, and `.dot` declares26x26px with padding0. Selected state is only `.sel` styling. Actual hit-box dimensions are NOT measured.
- Direction: give each existing color a meaningful distinct name, bind selection state, provide a non-color selection cue, and keep the small swatch inside a46px target. Preserve palette values/team behavior. Boundary: dark/light, keyboard on/off selection, each side distinguishable,320px wrapping. Treat this as one palette-control root rather than one finding per option or separate quota entries for its related accessibility symptoms.

**W3-C05 - Cornhole editor references undefined color aliases (provisional low; rendered impact unverified).**

- Source: `src\lib\games\cornhole\CornholeEditor.svelte:549,597,640,666,691,698-699`; semantic tokens are declared in `src\app.css:1-8,54-77`.
- `--fg` is used for Sides/move/name/chip foreground and selection border; `--brand` for selected-member border/background. Source search across all CSS/Svelte/TS under src found **no declarations of either alias**. Existing defined equivalents are `--text` and `--primary`. This is not a guessed contrast finding: invalid CSS variable substitution is confirmed, but actual computed colors/focus/selected-member appearance remain unverified.
- Intended browser reproduction: dark/light Sides editor, type a name, select a member, and compare computed text and selected-member styles to the app's defined semantic tokens. Direction if impact reproduced: bind these local declarations to existing tokens, not invent new global aliases. Boundary: both themes, selected/unselected member, name entry, move/cancel and unchanged actual team colors. Keep separate from C04 only if runtime confirms an independently visible defect.

### Coverage, exclusions and duplicate check

**Finite SOURCE review exhausted:** Skull King bids/won/bounty; Cornhole toss/team management; Codenames winner/ending/team roster (not recent Extras work); Uno and Uno Golf out/hand entry; Golf manual/grid entry; Chicken Foot pips/out/double-blank/clear; Tally step/reset/projection/target; shared Stepper naming/bounds and relevant CSS. No scoring/rule defect is proposed. Shared small-button sizing, shell/help, excluded Hearts work and wave1/wave2 pages were not counted.

**All requested RUNTIME scenarios remain untested:**320/390/1280px x dark/light; empty/populated synthetic entries; long names; selected/unselected/invalid/completed and edit modes; clipping/overflow; numeric/status consistency; required-field entry/clearing; label association/focus/AT; color-independent state; measured46px targets. Source review is not scenario completion. Stopped because runtime is unavailable, not because ten findings were reached or actual UI scenarios were exhausted.

Bounded GitHub check: at most100 all-state issues sorted by update, at most50 open PRs, then at most30 all-state issues matching grid/bounty/Cornhole/Uno/touch-target terms; no matching root-cause fix surfaced. Tracker #233 and its latest handoff were checked before this comment. Excluded current Hearts PR #232/#231 and recent Codenames Extras #224/#223. These searches do not prove that another not-yet-filed discovery has no overlap: parent must deduplicate before acceptance.

**Handoff:** resume only these finite editor scenarios in a browser-enabled isolated context using synthetic records and the exact matching build; prioritize C01 and then confirm/discard C02-C05. Refresh source SHA/line references if main moves. This wave contributes **0 UI-verified fixes**, while preserving source-reproduced evidence rather than speculative quota entries. No individual issue should be filed solely from this report.

comments.text:
## Wave4 supplemental handoff — 7 high-confidence SOURCE CANDIDATES

**Every candidate below is runtime-unverified. Accepted/reproduced UI defects: 0. Fixes: 0. Do not file or count these until the parent reproduces them in the actual UI.** This supplements the [environment-blocker report](https://github.com/jrmoulckers/score-king/issues/233#issuecomment-6619733471) following the parent's explicit request for source candidates.

All citations refer to inspected checkout SHA **e71c744b1518e6ec6d90e22a0061936fd7e090a9**, not the latest future deployment. Likely implementation owner throughout: **web engineer**, with design engineer input for target geometry. Severity is provisional pending reproduction. No production edits, individual issues, agents, dependency retries, or real records/services.

### W4-SC01 — Switching round type silently destroys the unsaved editor draft
**Provisional severity: medium. Method: direct handler and constructor inspection; no rendered UI test.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/scrabble/ScrabbleEditor.svelte:31-39,88-105`; `src/lib/games/scrabble/logic.ts:105-118`; `src/lib/games/upwords/UpwordsEditor.svelte:27-34,68-85`; `src/lib/games/upwords/logic.ts:73-98`.

Validation steps: Start a synthetic two-player Scrabble game, enter Word value 20 and enable Bingo; select Final tally and then Turn again. In Upwords, select a player, set Word 1 letters to 4, add a second word, then select End of game and return to Turn. Repeat while editing a populated round without saving.

Expected: an accidental round-type excursion is recoverable, or explicitly warns before discarding a populated unsaved draft. Source-predicted actual: Scrabble reconstructs a zero-point/non-bingo turn; Upwords reconstructs only one two-letter word and resets bonuses/active player. Both replace the entire bound input with an empty constructor, with no editor-local preservation or confirmation.

Smallest holistic repair: handle destructive type switches consistently in these two editors using existing confirmation UX or editor-local unsaved drafts. This concerns transient editing UX, **not** stored-data/schema migration or altered scoring. Parent should confirm intended discard behavior before choosing preservation versus confirmation. Adjacent regressions: pristine mode switches, cancel-confirm leaves the draft untouched, confirmed switch works, and populated historical round remains unchanged until Save.

### W4-SC02 — Custom radio groups expose radio semantics without radio keyboard behavior
**Provisional severity: medium. Method: markup/handler inspection; no keyboard or assistive-tech execution. One pattern candidate, not one per game.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/yahtzee/YahtzeeEditor.svelte:112-131`; `src/lib/games/catan/CatanEditor.svelte:70-84`; `src/lib/games/scrabble/ScrabbleEditor.svelte:88-107,127-143,191-208`; `src/lib/games/ginrummy/GinRummyEditor.svelte:94-109`; `src/lib/games/cribbage/CribbageEditor.svelte:114-129`. These are ordinary buttons with `role="radio"`/`aria-checked`, click handlers, no local arrow-key handler, and no roving tabindex.

Validation steps: In a Yahtzee fixed-score round, Tab to one choice and press Right/Left; in Catan do the same in Longest Road/Largest Army; repeat for Scrabble round type/active player, Gin Rummy knocker, and Cribbage dealer. Inspect focus order and accessibility roles, with a screen reader only if actually available.

Expected: semantics and interaction agree: radio arrow navigation/selection and one group tab stop, or appropriately labeled toggle-button semantics if retaining independent Tab/Space controls. Source-predicted actual: native buttons do not gain radio keyboard behavior merely from ARIA; every choice remains independently tabbable and arrows do not invoke the component selection handler. This is an ARIA interaction mismatch, **not** a claim that keyboard users cannot select with Space.

Smallest holistic repair: consistently reuse native radio controls, an already-reviewed radio helper, or appropriate pressed-button semantics. Do not invent a helper per consumer. Adjacent regressions: Space selection, checked state/focus stays coherent after pointer use, and Catan/Scrabble's currently supported tap-again-to-clear behavior is preserved rather than accidentally removed.

### W4-SC03 — Stateful option buttons omit the programmatic selected state
**Provisional severity: medium. Method: markup inspection; no screen-reader reproduction. One repeated-pattern candidate.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/azul/AzulEditor.svelte:78-85`; `src/lib/games/scrabble/ScrabbleEditor.svelte:159-165`; `src/lib/games/ginrummy/GinRummyEditor.svelte:112-124`; `src/lib/games/cribbage/CribbageEditor.svelte:138-144`. State changes update `class:on` and an `aria-hidden` mark, but these buttons do not expose `aria-pressed`/checked state. The inspected scoped search for `aria-pressed`, `aria-checked`, `onkeydown`, and `tabindex` confirms the missing state on those controls. Existing Canasta/Upwords toggles demonstrate the repository's pressed-state pattern.

Validation steps: Inspect the accessibility tree before/after activating Azul Final round, Scrabble Bingo, Gin Rummy Went gin, and Cribbage His heels. Then validate announcements with available desktop assistive technology; do not imply physical-device coverage.

Expected: the selected/not-selected value is available programmatically (WCAG 4.1.2 candidate). Source-predicted actual: button name/role has no explicit selected-state property; the visible checkmark is hidden from the accessibility tree.

Smallest holistic repair: bind `aria-pressed` to the same boolean driving the visual state, consistently across all four options. Adjacent regressions: initial and edit-open state, toggling back off, disabled Gin without a knocker, and unchanged scoring/visibility behavior.

### W4-SC04 — Rummikub's fixed seven-column keypad cannot maintain 46px-wide targets at 320px
**Provisional severity: medium. Method: CSS constraint inspection, not measured browser geometry.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/rummikub/TileKeypad.svelte:63-84,106-114`; consumer `src/lib/games/rummikub/RummikubEditor.svelte:112-120`. The keypad has seven equal columns and six 6px gaps, sets only key min-height 46px, and has no narrow-width reflow/min-width rule.

Validation steps: Open a synthetic Rummikub round at 320px, leaving at least one non-winner's rack visible; measure every tile/joker button's bounding rectangle. Repeat 390/1280px and both themes. Distinguish compressed targets from overflow; this is not an intentional horizontal-scroll complaint.

Expected: both interactive dimensions meet the repository's 46px floor. Source-predicted actual: even if the pad occupied the entire 320px viewport with **no** parent padding, equal tracks would be at most `(320 - 6*6)/7 = 40.57px`; nested cards reduce room further. Browser validation must establish whether tracks compress or instead overflow due to intrinsic sizing.

Smallest holistic repair: responsive keypad column count with a 46px minimum inline target size, retaining tile order and the joker key. Adjacent regressions: 13 numbered tiles plus joker remain accessible, two-joker cap, key labels/order, long player names and existing rack controls.

### W4-SC05 — Dominion deck-size input opts out of the 46px control-height floor
**Provisional severity: low. Method: exact local CSS inspection; no bounding-box measurement.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/dominion/DominionEditor.svelte:109-125,235-245`. The Deck size field uses `class="pts sm"`; `.pts` height is 46px but `.pts.sm` explicitly overrides it to 40px.

Validation steps: Open Dominion's Gardens section at 320/390/1280px in both themes and measure the actual Deck size input hit rectangle alongside adjacent controls; type a legal deck size such as 40.

Expected: existing deck-size input follows the same >=46px project target-height contract. Source-predicted actual: local styling computes 40px height. This is a **project ergonomics constraint**, not a claim that 40px alone violates WCAG's smaller minimum target criterion.

Smallest holistic repair: remove the smaller-height override while preserving appropriate width, labels and Gardens wrapping. Adjacent regressions: keyboard editing, legal long numeric display, Gardens subtotal, and no narrow-width field overlap.

### W4-SC06 — Gin Rummy's chosen-player badge still says 'knocked' when Went gin is selected
**Provisional severity: low. Method: conditional markup inspection; no UI reproduction.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/ginrummy/GinRummyEditor.svelte:55-59,94-124,77-81,166-181`. The selected player's badge is unconditionally `knocked`; the editor separately selects `input.gin` and presents the Gin outcome.

Validation steps: Select Ada as the knocker, enable Went gin, and enter legal opponent deadwood, e.g. Bea 10. Compare Ada's selected-player badge with Went gin and the result label. Toggle gin off and repeat on edit-open.

Expected: the chosen-player badge reflects the currently selected ending, or uses neutral wording that is correct for both. Source-predicted actual: Ada remains marked 'knocked' while the form/result explicitly says Gin. This is text consistency only; no change to scoring/rules or the internal `knockerId` contract is proposed.

Smallest holistic repair: condition badge copy on `input.gin` or use accurate neutral selection copy. Adjacent regressions: ordinary knock and undercut labels remain correct, Gin zero-deadwood field remains unchanged, edit-open badge matches stored option.

### W4-SC07 — Rummy winner explanation displays the base award while its preview displays the doubled award
**Provisional severity: medium. Method: inspection of two bindings to already-computed display values; no scoring-rule audit or runtime reproduction.**

Sources: `src/lib/games/rummy/RummyEditor.svelte:14-15,119,151-160,165-172`. Header uses `scoop`; winner note uses `deadwood` directly. The existing optional Went Rummy control says 'double the score'.

Validation steps: In a synthetic Rummy game with its existing Rummy-bonus option enabled, select Ada as Went out, enter Bea's number-card face value 10 with zero faces/aces, and enable Went Rummy. Compare header award with Ada's note; disable the option and compare again.

Expected: the winner's explanatory award agrees with the preview, or clearly labels 10 as the base plus the bonus to produce 20. Source-predicted actual: header shows +20 but Ada's 'Scoops the table's deadwood' note shows +10 with no bonus breakdown in that note. Both values already exist; the proposed repair is **display binding/copy only**, not math, schema, or rule changes.

Smallest holistic repair: use `scoop` in final-award copy, or label base and multiplier explicitly using existing derived values. Adjacent regressions: bonus disabled/off, zero deadwood, singular/plural point copy, and editing a round that already has Went Rummy selected.

### Coverage, duplicate search, limits, and continuation

Source inspection covered the twelve assigned editor entry/control surfaces and relevant local CSS; Canasta, Phase 10 and remaining branches supplied no additional confidently in-scope candidate. Scoring/schema/sync/auth concerns and subjective restyling were not submitted. Radio and pressed-state patterns are grouped rather than expanded per consumer. Shared Stepper was inspected but is not submitted as a separate defect.

Bounded duplicate lookup: latest 100 open/closed issues, plus 20 open PRs from the earlier pass. No matching root-cause-specific title was found in that bounded result; original game-addition issues are context, not proof of duplication. Parent must deduplicate these stable IDs against other wave reports before validation/filing.

**Actual scenario execution remains blocked, not passed/exhausted:** empty/populated/invalid/edit UI, synthetic long names/legal large values, focus, naming, overflow and feedback across 320/390/1280px light/dark. No browser-control tool, installed resolvable Playwright/Puppeteer, or approved local browser runtime was available; details and exact-head artifact are in the initial report. Finite source review is complete; these seven candidates exhaust this bounded follow-up. Parent/browser-enabled QA should validate the concrete sequences above with the exact-head artifact before assigning repairs or adding to the 50-fix count.

## Wave5 discovery handoff - 8 reproduced UI root-cause groups

**Discovery only; 0 repairs delivered.** No production edits, individual issues, agents, installs, accounts, paired games, or real game records. Parent must deduplicate/assign/count repairs, not count this report as fixes.

**Provenance:** isolated worktree HEAD `e71c744b1518e6ec6d90e22a0061936fd7e090a9` matched GitHub main at intake. Actual UI executed from the successful exact-head [CI run 41750582447](https://github.com/jrmoulckers/score-king/actions/runs/41750582447), `score-king-web` artifact `13285139626`. At handoff main was `0b278e0ec0b5514a406de135fdcf83738a788a5a`; read-only compare confirms every owning editor below is unchanged. The only intervening GamePlay markup change adds Hearts-only MoonScoringChoice branches, irrelevant to these editors. Findings cite the executed SHA, not a claimed execution of the newer build.

**Actual browser evidence:** headless Edge `156.0.4314.58`, raw Chrome DevTools Protocol via Node's built-in WebSocket, dedicated `.qa-wave5-browser` profile AND new browser context, loopback-only artifact server `127.0.0.1:9416`. External HTTPS/WSS requests blocked in the context. This required no Playwright package or npm restoration. Measurements are CSS px in desktop-browser viewport emulation, not physical phones. Inspected actual rendered DOM, bounding boxes and AX tree; interactions used synthetic DOM click/input/change events. No screen-reader software, touch hardware, screenshots or live-site claims.

**Common synthetic setup:** game IDs `wave5-<module>`, players `wave5-p0...p5`; first name is the legal maximum-length 40-character `AlexandriaLongUnbrokenNameForSyntheticQA`, others `Tester 1...`. Active games use four players, six for social games. Fixtures enable Seer/blind-nil/spot-on where relevant. Open `/play/wave5-<module>`; editor is the card containing `.save-round`. Sizes 320/390/1280 x height 900, dark/light via `document.documentElement.dataset.theme`; native device scale 1.

### W5-01 - Stardew category labels collide with their score controls on phones
Severity **P2 / medium**. Source/owners: `src/lib/games/stardew/StardewEditor.svelte:117-143,264-297` at executed SHA.

Repro: open fresh Stardew season, inspect the first category (Bundles restored / Community Center rooms completed) at 320 or 390. Expected: label, description, tally and stepper occupy distinct readable regions. Actual measured first `.crow` width 243px at 320; fixed `.right` is 212px, `.label` shrinks to **0px** and the strong label extends **91.58px into the right controls**. At 390 the label is 63px, overlap **28.58px**, label height 122px. Same results in both themes. At 1280 label width 237.36px, height 44px, no overlap.

Root: horizontal flex category row plus nonshrinking tally+stepper group, while label is allowed to collapse to zero without a narrow-layout alternative. Repair: stack/wrap the control region below the category on narrow widths while retaining category context, cumulative caps and shared Stepper. Regression: 320/390 no label/control overlap for every category, normal desktop alignment, capped/completed and edited-season states unchanged. No scoring changes needed.

### W5-02 - Volleyball's two-column court clips rally controls at 320px
Severity **P2 / medium**. Source/owner: `src/lib/games/volleyball/VolleyballEditor.svelte:722-726,749-762,956-1009,1399-1403`.

Repro: fresh Volleyball with ordinary default team names Sharks/Eagles, 320px. Expected: both team cards and rally controls fit the editor without sideways page overflow. Actual: editor `clientWidth=275`, `scrollWidth=320` (**45px overflow**); second side ends at x=334.81 and second plus button at x=321.81. Both plus buttons are only **44.91px wide**. At 390 there is no editor overflow and plus width is 49.5; at 1280 width 282. Both themes reproduce. This is not an intentional scorecard scroller and does not require long names.

Root: `grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr` keeps two min-content side cards plus fixed 26px net, while each card also reserves 52px minus, gaps/padding and plus text; max-width360 only reduces score font. Repair: adapt the court grid/cards at the narrow breakpoint (e.g. stack cards/relocate net) and preserve >=46px control widths. Regression: empty, rally-added, deuce/completed, undo and legacy per-side decrement layouts, without changing rally/scoring rules.

### W5-03 - Legal long player names force editor-level horizontal overflow
Severity **P2 / medium**. **One conservative repeated roster-layout group, not one bug per game.** Owners: `src/lib/games/wizard/WizardEditor.svelte:70-83,112-124`; `spades/SpadesEditor.svelte:185-203,314-316`; `euchre/EuchreEditor.svelte:143-159,336-348,372-376`; `findingfriends/FindingFriendsEditor.svelte:90-105,227-247`; `holdem/HoldemEditor.svelte:199-214,314-326`; `tworooms/TwoRoomsEditor.svelte:328-340,680-697` (all under `src/lib/games`).

Repro: fresh editors using the 40-char name above. Expected: roster identity remains readable/accessible while controls stay inside the editor. Actual editor overflow at320/390 respectively: **Wizard195/125px, Spades156/86px, Euchre195/125px, Finding Friends182/112px, Holdem134/64px, Two Rooms147/77px**. Both themes. At1280 these editors fit. Examples at320: Euchre's second calling-team button ends x485; Finding Friends first banking chip ends x472. Other editors (e.g. Wingspan, Mario Kart) already constrain names successfully.

Root: unbounded min-content names in flex headers/chips/team buttons, including nowrap chip names and missing max-width/min-width/break handling. Repair: bound name-bearing flex items/chips and wrap or ellipsize only identity text while retaining full accessible names, avatars, roles and numeric/action regions. Holistic sweep of these owners; **do not modify global row CSS or accounting**. Regression: short/40-char/unbroken and spaced names at320/390; selected chips, team rosters and score preview numbers remain usable; desktop unchanged. Parent may deduplicate further if another wave reports the same repeated pattern.

### W5-04 - Switching Salad Bowl teams silently discards the unbanked turn tally
Severity **P2 / medium**. Owner: `src/lib/games/saladbowl/SaladBowlEditor.svelte:223-243,278-292,314-333`.

Repro: fresh round, Team1 active; click Got one! twice (Start is optional), then click Team2 on-the-clock chip without Bank. Expected: existing two-word tally is preserved or the user explicitly confirms/discards it; team switching must not silently erase it. Actual DOM before: `2 this turn`, team total inputs `[0,0]`; immediately after switching: `0 this turn`, inputs still `[0,0]`. Switching back does not recover words. Reproduced at all three widths in both themes.

Root: `selectTeam` changes activeTeam and unconditionally assigns `turnWords=0` before resetting clock; it bypasses endTurn's bank path. Repair: protect team switching with a clear pending-turn decision or prevent switching until existing Bank/discard flow resolves. Do not invent new per-team storage/schema or silently bank without an explicit choice. Regression: two-word pending turn, zero-word switch, bank-and-advance, paused/running timer, existing team totals and edit behavior.

### W5-05 - Winner-only Kittens mode removes the control needed to clear a chosen survivor
Severity **P2 / medium**. **One duplicated branch root across two modules.** Owners: `src/lib/games/explodingkittens/ExplodingKittensEditor.svelte:83-86,150-162,192-207`; `src/lib/games/implodingkittens/ImplodingKittensEditor.svelte:81-84,129-141,171-186`.

Repro: synthetic configs `trackOrder:false`; tap any Tap to crown row, then tap that selected survivor again. Expected: tap again clears the choice, as each existing crown handler explicitly implements. Actual: selection replaces the selected row with `.krow.survivor` **DIV**, leaving three alternative buttons. Clicking selected DIV does nothing; survivor count stays1. Reproduced both games at320/390/1280, both themes. Choosing another player works, so this is a reset/correction trap, not a completely blocked winner workflow.

Root: survivor display branch precedes the winner-only interactive branch, making the handler's deselect path unreachable for the selected player. Repair: keep the selected winner row an accessible pressed button when trackOrder is off; preserve the noninteractive automatic survivor for order-tracking mode. Regression: winner-only choose/clear/change using pointer and keyboard, order-based eliminate/revive and auto-survivor, opening recorded winner-only match for editing. No winner/scoring logic changes.

### W5-06 - Presidents labels an unentered finishing place as President
Severity **P3 / low**. Owner: `src/lib/games/presidents/PresidentsEditor.svelte:31-33,124-145`.

Repro: synthetic recorded round with positions1/2/3/4; click Edit round1, clear first player's numeric finishing place (input/change). Because sorting moves the blank row last, inspect that named player's row, not the first remaining row. Expected: missing/unentered finish displays neutral placeholder, not a successful President rank. Actual blank player's input is `''`, rank remains `👑 President`, accessible label is **`Finished —: President`**, while validation correctly asks where that player finished. Repeated at320/390/1280; this targeted invalid edit was run in the retained light context, not independently re-run in dark.

Root: `titleFor(finish || 1,n)` substitutes first place for any unentered zero/blank value, and markup renders that title unconditionally. Repair: render neutral no-finish text/icon until finish is valid; retain current valid-rank logic and existing validator. Regression: blank typed finish, valid President/other ranks, duplicate positions, new and edited rounds; no default-position or scoring-rule changes.

### W5-07 - Example/generic placeholders substitute for actual field-purpose labels
Severity **P2 / medium accessibility**. **One conservative form-label association group.** Owners: `src/lib/games/werewords/WerewordsEditor.svelte:122-140`; `src/lib/games/findingfriends/FindingFriendsEditor.svelte:109-140`.

Repro: focus secret-word input in Werewords and exact captured-points input in Finding Friends; inspect actual Edge AX tree. Expected: fields identify their visible purposes ('The secret word' and 'Points the challengers captured'), independent of example text. Actual Werewords textbox name is **`e.g. PYRAMID`**, exclusively from placeholder; Finding Friends spinbutton name is **`Exact points`**, exclusively placeholder, with no indication whose points. DOM fields have neither label association nor aria-label/labelledby. Placeholder text is not a durable association with the adjacent purpose text.

Repair: associate existing visible text with each control using label/for or aria-labelledby, not new copy or features. Regression: AX names before/after typing, keyboard focus, existing min/max/step/capping and secret-word entry unchanged. Baseline DOM lack of association reproduced in all six viewport/theme combinations; AX tree captured at1280 only. WCAG1.3.1/3.3.2 concern; no claimed real screen-reader test or full conformance audit.

### W5-08 - Locally sized social-game controls violate the 46px target floor
Severity **P3 / low**. **One conservative local-sizing group; parent should deduplicate against other sizing findings rather than count consumers separately.** Owners: `src/lib/games/avalon/AvalonEditor.svelte:673-687`; `src/lib/games/werewords/WerewordsEditor.svelte:363-378`; `src/lib/games/saladbowl/SaladBowlEditor.svelte:481-495`; `src/lib/games/volleyball/VolleyballEditor.svelte:588-598,801-813`. Botc also reproduced this pattern (alive40px, alignment/reveal/demon/notes38px), but not assigned separate IDs.

Repro: open fresh editor, measure controls with getBoundingClientRect. Actual **Avalon vote beads40px high, Werewords Need a word36px, Salad Bowl team chips40px, Volleyball Manage teams and team-select headers40px**. All three widths and both themes. Expected repo floor >=46px for interactive controls. Root is game-local numeric min-height overriding the shared sizing expectation, not the shared `.btn.small` variant (that shared issue is excluded here). Repair relevant local min-height to46 and validate narrow wrapping. Regression: every affected target measured >=46 in both dimensions where applicable, focus ring, selected/expanded states; no extra screen overflow. This is a measured product-contract defect, **not a claim that WCAG AA universally requires46px**. W4-SC05 is a separate source-only Dominion input sizing candidate; parent owns conservative bundling.

### Duplicate corroboration - do NOT add a ninth new root

W4-SC03 already reports stateful buttons missing programmatic selection. Actual wave5 UI confirms additional consumers: Spades Nil selected -> `.toggle.on`, `aria-pressed=null`, `aria-checked=null`; Finding Friends80-point quick choice -> `.qbtn.on`, `aria-pressed=null`. Owners `SpadesEditor.svelte:225-244`, `FindingFriendsEditor.svelte:112-120`. Treat as **runtime corroboration/extra consumers of W4-SC03**, not an additional wave5 root/fix. W3-SC03/04 report analogous patterns elsewhere. Bounded duplicate lookup reviewed70 open/recent-closed issues, then35 created since2026-11-04 and existing campaign comments; no separate already-filed issue matched the eight titles. Parent remains authoritative for concurrent assignments.

### Bounded coverage, omissions, and stop condition

**Finite baseline pass exhausted:** rendered fresh editor cards at320/390/1280, dark/light, legal40-char name; DOM geometry, missing field association and local-control target checks for24 existing editors: Wingspan/Wyrmspan/Finspan/Stardew/Wizard/Spades/Euchre/Finding Friends/Presidents/Kings Corners/Holdem/Mario Kart/Volleyball/Spikeball/Fluff/Avalon/Werewords/Two Rooms/Salad Bowl/Exploding Kittens/Imploding Kittens/ERS/Blood on the Clocktower/Secret Hitler. Targeted selected/populated/invalid/edit scenarios above completed. Short transient initial-load missing-card observations for Mario Kart/Salad Bowl were discarded, not filed. Finspan40px CSS inputs actually retain the global46px minimum in DOM, so that apparent source candidate was discarded. No contrast guesses, radius preferences or intentional scoreboard scrolling counted.

**Not exhausted/passed:** exhaustive per-game scoring combinations or full invalid/populated/edit matrix for all24; full keyboard/AT audit; every advanced disclosure, tournament/team management dialog, timer-expiry/background timing, secret-role finale, sports deuce/legacy edit, full Holdem betting/settlement. These remain omitted to keep discovery bounded; no rule/accounting/storage/auth/sync work proposed. No physical-device or live-service evidence. Excluded shells/setup/settings/help and assigned games were not audited for defects.

**Runtime cleanup/status:** owned server and browser are being shut down after this handoff. Only local untracked `.qa-wave5-dist` exact-head build and `.qa-wave5-browser` synthetic profile were created for execution; no tracked file changed. Retained runtime scratch is not a proposed commit. No repeated private-package install/registry/cache/credential workaround. Parent can use the artifact+registered headless Edge+raw CDP method in approved synthetic contexts if its packaged browser tooling is similarly unavailable.

## Discovery wave 2 — 10 reproduced root causes for parent triage

**Discovery only: 0 fixes shipped by this wave.** Parent: validate/deduplicate these IDs, file accepted defects individually, and route repairs to `@web-engineer`; do not count this comment as a fix. All references below are to tested source **`e71c744b1518e6ec6d90e22a0061936fd7e090a9`**, which matched fetched `origin/main` and the isolated checkout when discovery began. The checkout HEAD remained that SHA and production files stayed unchanged.

### Runtime and evidence

Used the successful exact-head CI run https://github.com/jrmoulckers/score-king/actions/runs/41750582447 and its unexpired `score-king-web` artifact (ID `13285139626`). An owned, OS-selected localhost port served the downloaded artifact; the entry referenced `assets/index-yvvRhmFA.js`. Existing Microsoft Edge **156.0.4314.58**, launched with a new repository-local synthetic-only profile, was exercised through Chrome DevTools Protocol using Node's built-in WebSocket. No dependency installation, credentials/configuration work, production edits, individual issue creation, additional agents, or existing service changes were performed. Both owned helpers were stopped and the checkout is clean.

Browser DOM measurements, actual control interactions, CDP keyboard events and Chromium accessibility-tree inspection support the findings. Screenshots were visually inspected, not inferred from source. Synthetic fixture: two legitimate <=40-character player names (`Alexandria Catherine Montgomery-Williams`, `AlexandriaCatherineMontgomeryWilliams`); three recently finished Tally games with two rounds each; one custom definition named `Friday tournament scorer` (24 characters), standard 2–8-player limits, counter input. Shared recap used a synthetic `skr1.r` URL fragment, never a real account or imported backup.

Evidence retained in the approved session artifacts directory under `files\wave2-e71c744`: `.qa-wave2-custom.png`, `.qa-wave2-manage.png`, `.qa-wave2-reset.png`, `.qa-wave2-recap.png`, `.qa-wave2-night.png`, downloaded runtime and synthetic browser profile. These are local artifacts, not uploaded public attachments.

### W2-01 — Custom-game player-limit controls overflow ordinary phones

**Severity:** P2; web, responsive form usability.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/CustomGameEdit.svelte:351–358` nests both 166px Steppers plus `min`/`max` labels in a nonwrapping `.row`. Wrapping the outer `.optrow` does not wrap this inner cluster. Shared row behavior is `src/app.css:315–321`.

**Repro:** Fresh `/create`, scroll to Limits & players at 320px or 390px, either theme, default text. Also reproduces editing the safe custom definition. **Expected:** both player bounds and +/- controls remain visible and usable without accidental document overflow. **Actual/evidence:** inner cluster measures 410px; document scrollWidth is 441px at both 320/390 widths; max increment button sits at x=395, width=46. At XL, document grows to 455px; text-only 200% zoom gives 488px. Not a deliberately scrollable widget. Desktop1280 does not overflow.

**Owner/fix:** `CustomGameEdit.svelte`; give each bound its own wrapping/labeled row or wrap the inner cluster without shrinking hit areas. **Regression:** create/edit, min>max validation, 320/390/1280, XL and 200% text expansion; preserve player-limit values and step behavior.

### W2-02 — Five custom-game numeric fields have indistinguishable accessible names

**Severity:** P2; keyboard/assistive-technology form usability, WCAG 1.3.1/4.1.2.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/CustomGameEdit.svelte:342,349,355,357,365` omits the existing Stepper `label` prop at every call. `src/lib/components/Stepper.svelte:17–19,60–80` therefore falls back to `Value`, `Decrease`, `Increase`. Visible field labels are plain divs, not associated labels.

**Repro:** Open `/create`; tab through Target score, Round limit, minimum/maximum Players and Points per tap. Inspect browser accessibility tree. **Expected:** each number/control names the setting being changed. **Actual/evidence:** all five spinbuttons are named exactly `Value` (values 0,0,2,8,1); corresponding buttons have generic decrease/increase names. This is actual Chromium AX output, not a claimed Narrator/VoiceOver session.

**Owner/fix:** `CustomGameEdit.svelte`, reuse Stepper's existing label API; include distinct Minimum players/Maximum players and direction-aware target wording. **Regression:** all five fields and their buttons, high/low win direction, keyboard traversal and edit mode. No shared Stepper rewrite is necessary.

### W2-03 — Manage-games action cluster overlaps names and clips custom actions

**Severity:** P2; names/actions unreadable on phones.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/ManageGames.svelte:193–214,236–241`: list uses `overflow:hidden`, row never wraps, info has `min-width:0`, and action cluster has `flex:none`. Custom Edit/Duplicate add enough width to consume the entire row. Name text has no protective wrapping/layout constraint.

**Repro:** Add the safe 24-character custom game, open `/manage-games` at 320/390px, scroll to its row; repeat XL. **Expected:** identifiable game name and all Edit/Duplicate/Favorite/Hide actions have distinct, visible hit areas. **Actual/evidence:** at320 default text info width=0; action cluster x=43,width=266 extends beyond card edge. At390 info has only35px, less than emoji+gap, effectively no name column. At320 XL name box width=0 but its text paints over Edit/Duplicate; action width301 extends to x344 and Hide is clipped by the list. Screenshot confirms overlapping words and missing trailing action. Built-in rows also overlap longer names at XL, same root counted once.

**Owner/fix:** `ManageGames.svelte`; wrap actions beneath a full-width name region on constrained widths and keep title/emoji flex children contained. Do not hide actions or shorten saved names. **Regression:** built-in/custom/hidden/retired rows, search, long names, all actions, default/XL, mobile/desktop.

### W2-04 — Preference reset rows squeeze descriptions into an overlapping word column

**Severity:** P2; display/reflow failure.

**Source/root:** same pattern in `src/pages/Accessibility.svelte:164–177,259–265` and `src/pages/GameplaySettings.svelte:88–102,128–134`: nonwrapping reset row, shrinkable `meta`, unshrinkable reset button. Counted ONCE across both surfaces.

**Repro:** `/accessibility`, select XL (so reset is enabled), view Reset appearance at320px; also `/gameplay` with nondefault preferences. **Expected:** explanatory text and reset action reflow into readable regions. **Actual/evidence:** appearance description column width33px, scrollWidth113px, height876px; Reset to defaults button x78,width196 overlaps overflowing text. Screenshot shows a nearly screen-tall one-word column under the button. Even default320 text: meta width70 vs content87; gameplay has same pattern (70 vs77).390/1280 default are materially better.

**Owner/fix:** both preference pages; wrap/stack the reset button below its description at narrow/expanded text sizes. **Regression:** enabled and All default states, both pages, XL/200% text, no changes to reset scope or stored values.

### W2-05 — Settings says Gameplay “All off” while haptics remains on

**Severity:** P2; misleading local preference state.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/Settings.svelte:56–64,610` builds `gameplaySummary` from keepAwake/privacyGuard/roastMode but omits haptics. `src/pages/GameplaySettings.svelte:56–73` presents haptics as an ordinary gameplay toggle.

**Repro:** In `/gameplay`, turn off screen-awake, privacy guard and roasts, leaving Haptic feedback on; return to Settings. **Expected:** summary acknowledges the remaining enabled preference, not All off. **Actual/evidence:** browser has `navigator.vibrate` function; Haptic feedback checkbox checked=true,disabled=false; other three checked=false. Hub renders `Gameplay / All off`. Verified actual checkbox state and text, not only stored JSON.

**Owner/fix:** `Settings.svelte`; include haptics consistently in the gameplay summary, using existing vocabulary; keep unsupported-browser messaging in the detail page. **Regression:** haptics-only, all off, defaults, combined enabled preferences, supported/unsupported presentation.

### W2-06 — Wrapped range selection exposes no selected state

**Severity:** P2; accessible state missing, WCAG 4.1.2.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/Wrapped.svelte:208–213`: range buttons change only `.on`; enclosing role=group does not make them selectable controls.

**Repro:** With the safe finished games and lead player, open `/wrapped`; select Tonight or Last12 months, inspect accessibility tree. **Expected:** assistive technology can identify which mutually exclusive range is active. **Actual/evidence:** This year/Last12 months/Tonight remain ordinary buttons with no pressed/checked/selected property after selection; only visual styling reveals the choice.

**Owner/fix:** `Wrapped.svelte`; reuse the existing accessible Segmented pattern, or add correct state to existing controls without changing presets. **Regression:** mouse/keyboard range changes, selected state, empty ranges, same labels and reset-to-first-card behavior.

### W2-07 — Wrapped progress tabs lose focus/selection synchronization

**Severity:** P2; keyboard navigation inconsistency.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/Wrapped.svelte:169–178,259–275`: window-wide arrow handler advances index, while progress is a tablist with every tab focusable and no roving focus/tab-panel association. No focus update happens after next/prev.

**Repro:** With populated Wrapped, focus Card1 progress tab, press Right. **Expected:** coherent keyboard behavior: focused/selected tab moves together, or use honestly named ordinary carousel buttons instead of incomplete tabs. **Actual/evidence:** card becomes By the numbers; Card2 selected=true, but focused element remains Card1 with selected=false. All12 progress tabs have tabIndex0. Also reproduced Right advancing the card while focus is on the Last12 months range button, because handler is global. These are one keyboard-control root, not two findings.

**Owner/fix:** `Wrapped.svelte`; scope keyboard handling to the carousel, either implement complete tab behavior or use normal labeled carousel navigation buttons; preserve manual navigation and reduced motion. **Regression:** left/right boundaries, tab traversal, range-button focus, selected/focused state, changing card counts.

### W2-08 — Wrapped uses undersized range/progress hit areas

**Severity:** P2; violates the repository's measured >=46px interaction requirement (NOT a claim that 28px inherently fails WCAG's 24px minimum).

**Source/root:** `src/pages/Wrapped.svelte:301–302,415–420` hardcodes range min-height40px and progress width28,height32. Count these local Wrapped sizing rules ONCE.

**Repro:** Populated `/wrapped`, default text, any tested width/theme; measure range/progress buttons. **Expected:** >=46px actual interactive target dimensions while keeping dots visually small. **Actual/evidence:** three range buttons height40; each progress button28x32. Previous/next are correctly46px. Twelve-card fixture is a realistic populated story, not an artificially inflated number of controls.

**Owner/fix:** `Wrapped.svelte`; enlarge hit areas and allow sensible wrapping, retaining small inner dot marks and selected cues. **Regression:** 320/390/1280, long story, XL, no collision between controls. **Related but distinct:** #235 concerns shared `.btn.small` sizing; these are `.chip`/`.dot` local selectors, not the shared small-button rule. Deduplicate if parent deliberately broadens that repair to own this root too.

### W2-09 — Shared standings table pushes recap scores off screen with legitimate long names

**Severity:** P2; critical score display/reflow.

**Source/root:** `src/pages/Recap.svelte:93–99` renders shared Scoreboard without a containment/scroll boundary; `src/lib/components/Scoreboard.svelte:62–77,90–94` places name/avatar/award in nonwrapping flex content and no name shrink/wrap constraint. `src/app.css:315–321` supplies the nonwrapping row. The recap Scorecard separately uses intentional `.scroll` at `Recap.svelte:102`; do not conflate that native scrolling table with this overflow.

**Repro:** Open valid synthetic recap with the two <=40-character names above and scores100/90 at320px, XL; inspect final standings. **Expected:** names, rank and scores stay readable through deliberate reflow or an explicit local accessible scroll surface. **Actual/evidence:** shared standings table width581 in277px available content; document scrollWidth595 for320px viewport. Screenshot shows player text running out of the viewport and Score column entirely offscreen. Scorecard below fits its own277px region. Reproduced on the actual decoded recap page, no backup import or real records.

**Owner/fix:** shared `Scoreboard.svelte` and recap containment as needed; wrap/shrink name text without hiding scores, or introduce explicit local scrolling only if justified. Count this shared component root once across games, not per caller. **Regression:** ordinary/long/unbroken names, ties/winners/You badge, both themes/XL, caller boards; preserve intentional scorecard scroll.

### W2-10 — Selected preference text misses AA contrast even in High contrast mode

**Severity:** P2; measurable visual accessibility, WCAG 1.4.3.

**Source/root:** `src/lib/components/Segmented.svelte:98–101` hardcodes white text on `--primary`; `src/app.css:2` defines primary #7c5cff. High-contrast blocks at `src/app.css:90–100` change text/muted/borders, not this pairing. Count the shared selected/primary color pairing ONCE, not per settings group/button.

**Repro:** `/accessibility`, Medium text, enable High contrast; inspect selected Theme/Text size/Motion option in both dark and light. **Expected:** >=4.5:1 for 16px bold selected control labels (below the 18.67px bold large-text cutoff). **Actual/evidence:** confirmed `data-contrast` present in each theme; computed foreground rgb255,255,255/background rgb124,92,255; size16px,weight700. WCAG sRGB calculation yields **4.3461:1**, below4.5. This is not a rounding-to4.5 pass. XL text qualifies differently; do not claim every size fails.

**Owner/fix:** coordinate `@web-engineer` with local design ownership for `Segmented.svelte`/`app.css` and approved semantic-token pairing. Do not casually restyle Royal Violet or use Crown Gold/hover-only tokens as a workaround. **Regression:** normal/high-contrast, both themes, default/small/XL, all selected segments and related primary-label usages; preserve selected noncolor semantics/focus cues.

### Coverage, exclusions and limitations

- Exhausted baseline empty-state checks for Settings, Gameplay, Accessibility, ManageGames, Create, Nights, Wrapped and missing-fragment Recap at320/390/1280 in dark/light. No synthetic records were present for that baseline.
- Ran populated safe-record matrix for accessibility/gameplay/manage/custom edit/Nights list and dated detail/Wrapped/valid fragment Recap at those widths, both effective themes and Medium/XL. An initial fixture pass discovered lead-member prefs overriding requested localStorage values; that mislabeled pass was discarded and rerun with fixture member preferences matching the requested theme/scale. Actual computed theme/root font size was recorded, not assumed.
- Exercised local preference selection, High contrast, OLED on dark, Auto following emulated OS dark preference, System/Reduced following reduced-motion preference, reset controls, numeric guidance, keyboard and AX states. System reduced-motion produced1e-06s pulse duration; OLED produced actual black body background; Reset appearance returned default values and disabled itself. These correct behaviors are not findings.
- Added text-only200% expansion evidence. This is not a full browser-UI zoom/physical mobile/OS screen-reader certification. Chromium AX evidence is not claimed as spoken Narrator/VoiceOver output. No touch hardware, actual vibration or physical wake-lock operation was tested.
- Stopped at ten independently evidenced candidates, not a fifty-defect quota. No extra Night/long-name variants, merely subjective styling, or feature requests were padded into the count. Parent should recheck adjacent text reflow while repairing shared display roots rather than count each surface separately.

### W3-C01 - ACCEPT: clearing an actively populated Golf grid's final card leaves the hole score stale

**Severity:** P2 / medium. **Owner:** @web-engineer. **Files:** `src\lib\games\golf\GolfGrid.svelte:48-60,67-79`; `src\lib\games\golf\GolfEditor.svelte:64-71,93-95,147-156`, at executed SHA above.

**Actual reproduction:** open `/play/w3-golf-fresh`; Ada's initial score0. Open Tap the grid, open first cell, pick5. Rendered stepper=5, helper hole=5, projected total=5. Reopen that cell and choose the picker clear option. Actual: **no cards remain, helper hole=0, stepper=5 and projected total=5**. Expected: clearing the final card from a grid that has actively taken ownership of the score publishes0, just like the existing clear-all action. Reproduced in **12/12 cases** (three widths x two themes x fresh and populated edit modes). Directly reopening the original saved grid containing5 and clearing its only card also produced grid0/score5; this does not require starting from a manually typed score.

**Manual preservation boundary passed:** type17 manually and open an untouched empty helper. Helper shows0, but stepper/projected total correctly stay17 in12/12 cases. This is deliberate non-destructive helper behavior and must **not** be changed to automatic zeroing on every empty mount. After placing5, the helper correctly takes ownership and publishes5. **Clear-all boundary passed:** placing5 then the existing whole-grid clear button yields helper0/stepper0/projected0 in12/12 cases. Canceling the mistaken populated-round edit and reopening restored the original saved grid5/score5; the defect is draft clearing, not background mutation of saved records.

**Synthetic Save consequence confirmed:** after fresh-grid clear-last, Save round remained usable. The stored synthetic round had `scores['w3-p0']=5`, `deltas['w3-p0']=5` with that player's six grid cells allnull. Thus the inconsistent entry is saveable; this is not merely a transient animation or missing initialization.

**Root:** GolfGrid's effect publishes only when `filled && total !== prev`; removing the last card makes filledfalse and suppresses its zero transition. GolfEditor intentionally skips reconciliation while that grid is open. Clear-all bypasses this with `onscore(0)`.

**Small holistic repair:** track active helper editing separately from untouched emptiness and publish zero on an actively edited transition to no cards. Preserve untouched manual17 behavior, existing score callback, computeGrid/scoring and persisted shape. Regression boundaries: clear-last vs clear-all; untouched/manual helper; original populated edit/cancel/reopen; canceled-column zero; negative card values; save records agreeing with the actively edited grid. One root, not one finding per viewport/entry mode.

### W3-C02 - ACCEPT: correcting a mistaken went-out selection silently loses the previously entered leftover hand

**Severity:** P2 / medium. **Owner:** @web-engineer. **Files:** `src\lib\games\uno\UnoEditor.svelte:76-85`; `src\lib\games\unogolf\UnoGolfEditor.svelte:52-62`. **Actual reproduction:** open a fresh synthetic Uno or Uno Golf round, enter Ada Numbers12/Actions1/Wilds1 (default20/50 values). Actual rendered subtotal **82pts** in Uno / **+82strokes** in Uno Golf; three inputs are12,1,1. Mistakenly select Ada's Went out/Sank it, then tap it again to undo. Her fields reappear as **0,0,0** and subtotal0 rather than the already-entered82. Re-enter12/1/1, mistakenly select Ada, then choose Bea instead: Ada again reappears0/0/0. Both double-toggle and switching-to-another-player reproduced in **24/24 cases** (two consumers x three widths x two themes x fresh/populated edit). This is actual DOM state, not only the earlier handler replay.

**Deliberate vs accidental behavior:** selecting the actual winner appropriately hides their leftover controls and treats their own leftover hand as0. Uno correctly displays winner-scoops wording; Uno Golf correctly displays `Cleared the hole - 0 strokes` and total0. **Those rules/selected presentation are not defects and must remain unchanged.** The accepted defect is that reversing or correcting an *uncommitted mistaken selection* also destroys the prior draft tally for a player who is no longer selected, without a clear action or recovery. In a fresh round, deselection disables Save until a winner is chosen; after switching to another winner Save is enabled with the erased hand, so validation does not expose the mistake. In populated edit mode canceling the entire edit and reopening restores the original12/1/1; that confirms saved data is unchanged until explicit Save but is not a local undo of the mistaken selection.

**Synthetic Save consequences confirmed:** start Ada82, Bea5, Cy0; mistakenly select Ada, correct winner to Cy, Save round. Uno stored Ada's leftover hand allzero/left0 and Cy's earned delta **5**, instead of87 if the previously typed Ada82 had been preserved. Uno Golf stored Ada hand allzero and her own delta **0**, instead of82; Bea remains5 and actual out player Cy remains0. These are consequences of erased entry, **not a proposal to change scoring math**.

**Root:** both selection handlers immediately replace the selected hand with `{numbers:0,actions:0,wilds:0}`. Deselect/switch updates the out identity but has no draft recovery for the overwritten hand.

**Small holistic repair:** retain the pre-selection draft tally in ephemeral editor state so deselecting/switching a mistaken selection can restore it. Continue presenting/scoring the actual out player at0, keep explicit clear actions destructive as intended, and preserve existing save/schema contracts. Regression: A on/off; A->B; multiple corrections; fresh and populated edit; edit Cancel; explicit clear not undone; legitimate selected-player zero and standard winner scoop unchanged. Avoid broad scoring or persistence refactors.

### DEEP-02 - A modal results sheet lets wheel input move the page behind it

**Severity: P2 / medium. Platform: web modal interaction.**

**Current SHA/files:** `src/lib/components/ShareResultsSheet.svelte:153-175,230-261`; related shared modal lifecycle helper `src/lib/a11y/focusTrap.ts:55-82`. These are unchanged at current main.

**Exact reproduction:** At 390x600 on `/play/deep-g0`, focus **Share results**, press Enter, then Shift+Tab to **Done** and Tab back to **Share image**. With the modal still open, send mouse-wheel input at the backdrop above the sheet (`x=5,y=30,deltaY=400`), then press Escape.

**Expected:** The dialog scrolls internally as needed, but background position stays fixed for the entire modal lifecycle. Closing returns to the same content location/opener.

**Actual evidence:** Initially body overflow is `visible`, window scrollY is 0, and the fixed sheet occupies y=57..585. Wheel on the backdrop changes **window scrollY to 126** while the modal remains open. Escape correctly restores the Share results opener but leaves the background at scrollY 126. This is unintended background scrolling, not the intentional internal sheet scroll.

**Root/owning files:** ShareResultsSheet mounts a fixed backdrop and focus trap without locking the document scroll owner. `focusTrap` handles keyboard cycling/restoration only. PlaySheet has the same source lifecycle pattern, but was deliberately not opened because live/nearby services were excluded; do not claim its runtime reproduction or count it separately.

**Simple holistic repair/boundary:** Add lifecycle-scoped document scroll locking with exact restoration on teardown (a shared modal action/helper can cover existing sheets without changing their bodies). Keep internal overflow, Escape/backdrop/Done close, focus restoration and reduced-motion behavior intact. No sharing, QR, transport or results-display redesign. Test wheel over backdrop and scroll chaining at the sheet boundaries; preserve the opener's original scroll position after close.

**Adjacent passing evidence:** At 320/390/1280 in dark/light with OS reduced-motion emulation, Shift+Tab wraps to Done, Tab wraps to Share image and Escape restores the opener. Computed animation duration collapses to `1e-06s`. Internal sheet scrolling remains usable; it is not itself a defect.

### DEEP-03 - A failed lazy route chunk produces an unexplained blank page

**Severity: P2 / medium. Platform: web route failure/recovery.**

**Current SHA/files:** `src/lib/components/Lazy.svelte:20-37`, mounted for Nights at `src/App.svelte:164-169`; unchanged at current main.

**Exact reproduction:** In the owned context disable HTTP cache and block only the current local route JS chunk `*Nights-DWXlezsg.js*` with CDP Network.setBlockedURLs. Navigate freshly to `/nights` and wait for the entry/route request. Then remove the block and observe the existing page; recovery can be checked by going to History and selecting Game nights again.

**Expected:** Failure to load the existing page is surfaced as an actionable route error rather than an empty main area. A retry/reload/back recovery should be clearly available, without changing what the route does.

**Actual evidence:** Document title is **Game nights · Score King**, shell navigation is present, but main HTML is exactly **`<!----><!---->`** and no page/error/loading/retry text appears. The Nights JS resource is recorded with transferSize 0 while its CSS loads. Once the block is removed, navigating away to History and back to Game nights successfully loads the real night list; no data repair is needed.

**Root/owning files:** Lazy assigns Page only in `loader().then(...)`; rejected imports have no loading/error state or rejection handling, and its render condition emits nothing until Page exists. All routes using this wrapper share this root and count once.

**Simple holistic repair/boundary:** Surface the rejected load with repository-standard visible error feedback and a retry/reload recovery for that same loader, guarded against unmounted completions. Keep route contracts, lazy splitting, reactive props and normal navigation intact. This is an existing-route resilience repair, not new navigation, an offline cache strategy or infrastructure/dependency change.

**Limitation:** This was controlled single-local-chunk failure injection, not a real mobile network outage or proof of a particular deployed cache failure. The observed missing error state is actual runtime behavior under that injected failure.

### Coverage, exclusions and stop condition

Checked tracker #233 reports, issues #234..255 and subsequent wave3/wave4 replay reports before final reporting. None of the three repair roots above appears in those accepted sets; parent must still apply its final cross-session deduplication.

Passing recoverability checks: unknown single-segment game, unknown multi-segment route, missing saved game, malformed night date and valid-but-empty night date all present existing recovery affordances; valid synthetic Night list/detail links and browser back/forward preserve the correct date/content and focus main-content. Profile style controls expose pressed states, invalid local image URL produces a visible `role=alert` message without a service call, Cancel preserves data, and saving a gradient/Fox badge works.

Generic Countdown/timer editor/disclosure and date-picker/calendar components are **not present** in the shared in-scope implementation. Searches found only excluded game-specific timers/countdown costumes; these were not exercised or invented. No account/sync/live/nearby/QR-camera services, roster/list/create/setup/manage/settings/recap/Wrapped display roots, game-specific editors, Hearts/moon/help/meter choices, or real records were inspected as candidate bugs.

An overflow seen at 320px/150% text scaling was **discarded** as a standalone profile finding: profile-only DOM diagnostics did not isolate its root from the excluded outer Players layout. Existing target-size/selected-state/table-overflow groups were not counted. An initial QA server root-path guard error and selector/timing mistakes were corrected and are not app findings.

Owned browser and server have been stopped. Production files are unchanged; local synthetic evidence/runtime artifacts are retained under the repository's existing ignored `*.local` scratch convention. No build/tests were run because no production implementation changed. No screenshot-inspection or AX-tree claim is made for this pass.

### Provenance, method and safe fixture

Executed source/build **`619693be32fa62ffa0c06d22df0f218c9b7b221d`**, matching fetched main at resumed intake and this checkout HEAD. Successful **Web / Web CI** job in https://github.com/jrmoulckers/score-king/actions/runs/41754339645 supplied unexpired `score-king-web` artifact **13287846762**; actual browser entry was **`assets/index-CQBq6Xy-.js`**. Preliminary execution used the earlier 0b278e artifact with a read-only empty diff of core surfaces; **all findings below were subsequently reproduced on the named 619693b artifact in a newly created context**.

Registered headless Edge **156.0.4314.58**, Node built-in WebSocket/raw CDP; own fresh repository-local synthetic profile and browser context; OS-allocated loopback debug/server ports **64200/64204**. HTTPS/WSS blocked before navigation; only owned loopback pages were navigated. Actual rendered DOM, CSS-pixel bounding boxes, focus/control state and Chromium AX tree were inspected. All file:line references below are at **619693be32fa62ffa0c06d22df0f218c9b7b221d**. Owner is `@web-engineer`, with design coordination for responsive decisions.

### W1-01 — Shared PlayerSelect chips overflow with legal unbroken names

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/lib/components/PlayerSelect.svelte:35-56,99-115`.

**Repro:** Add the long unbroken fixture name; open `/tally` or `/hearts` at320/390px. **Expected:** every player choice stays within the form, retaining its full accessible identity and selection ordinal. **Actual:** name is a bare text flex item in an unbounded inline-flex button. **Fix:** bound the shared chip to available width and put identity text in a shrinkable/wrapping span; protect avatar/ordinal. **Regression:** short/spaced/unbroken names, selected ordinals, many players, both themes,320/390/1280. Count once across game setup consumers; not the separate round-editor or Scoreboard issue.

### W1-02 — Players grid expands its cards beyond the phone, hiding Edit controls

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/pages/Players.svelte:244-304,550-560,761-771`.

**Repro:** Populate Players with the two legal long names; open `/players` at320/390px. **Expected:** cards fit the roster grid; profile actions remain visible; the intended name ellipsis actually constrains text. **Actual:** grid uses a `1fr` track with intrinsic minimum sizing and nowrap names. Baseline card width **541.02px** causes document width555 at320 and390; after choosing a lead, a measured card is558.31px inside a277px grid and its Edit control starts at **x509.31**, entirely outside the320px viewport. Both themes reproduce; the editor inherits the expanded card.

**Fix:** use a zero-minimum grid track and contain the name-bearing flex chain so ellipsis is effective without sacrificing actions or accessible names. **Regression:** long/spaced names, lead/unclaimed tags, edit/gradient/save, archived rows, mobile and desktop grid. Distinct from W1-01: grid-track expansion, not the shared chip.

### W1-03 — Court's own member rows push standings figures off screen

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/pages/Court.svelte:129-155,162-181,196-223,232-263,487-517` (shared row baseline `src/app.css:315-328`).

**Repro:** Six synthetic finished games with the long-named winner; open `/court` at320/390px, then select that player as the device identity and revisit. **Expected:** names reflow while wins/win%/average/streak remain readable within each card. **Actual:** unbounded min-content identity flex items in Court's hand-built throne/standings/rivalry rows overflow. Without a device identity document width is **625px** at both mobile widths; with the You badge the first standings figures start at **x474.17** and end at **666.83**, while their row occupies x23..282. All four figures are outside the320px viewport. Both themes reproduce.

Preserve the existing intentionally scrollable head-to-head matrix. **Regression:** ordinary/long names, You badge, ties, all sorting/lenses, both themes and desktop. This is **not** shared `Scoreboard.svelte`/#253/W2-09; no score calculation change.

### W1-04 — Shared Segmented overflows when History adds its fourth status

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/lib/components/Segmented.svelte:44-88`; consumer `src/pages/History.svelte:70-73,305`.

**Repro:** Have at least six unarchived records including an abandoned game; open History at320px. **Expected:** all four status choices fit deliberate local reflow and have >=46px target dimensions. **Actual:** nowrap flex segments keep their label minima. Container is **277px** wide, x14..291; Abandoned extends x220.55..**327.78**, outside container and viewport. All shrinks to **40.34px** wide despite a46px height. ### W1-05 — Archiving the last abandoned game leaves History filtered by a vanished status

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/pages/History.svelte:53-55,70-73,85-86,109,188-194,305`; radio consequences `src/lib/components/Segmented.svelte:53-58`.

**Repro:** Eight unarchived records, exactly one abandoned. Select Abandoned, archive its only card, leaving seven records so filters remain mounted. **Expected:** when Abandoned ceases to be an offered status, the current filter returns to a valid choice and its radio remains keyboard-reachable. **Actual:** statusOptions removes Abandoned but `status` stays abandoned and effStatus still filters by it. UI says **No games match** although seven main-library records exist; all remaining radios report **aria-checked=false, tabindex=-1**. Clear filters recovers seven cards. Reproduced at320/dark and390/light; expanded archive rows must not be mistaken for visible filtered library results.

**Fix:** normalize the bound selected status when its dynamic option disappears, with focus recovery if the removed radio owned focus. **Regression:** archive/delete last abandoned at counts above/below6, Undo/restore, valid status preservation, keyboard entry. No storage/schema change is required.

### W1-06 — History's completed-game summary clips away the winner score and margin

**Severity P2.** Source/owner: `src/pages/History.svelte:226-259,636-675`.

**Repro:** Open History at320px with completed games, long-named winner and summary20/by10. **Expected:** the intended glanceable winner/result values survive responsive layout; only noncritical identity text may truncate deliberately. **Actual:** three fixed actions starve the metadata column, and the entire date/rounds/winner/score/margin line is one nowrap ellipsis region. **Fix:** reflow the card action cluster and give result identity/score/margin a bounded, wrapping summary layout instead of truncating the entire result sentence. **Regression:** active/finished/abandoned, short/long/tied winners, share/archive/delete targets and archived records, mobile/desktop. ### W1-07 — Preset Save/Cancel removes the focused form without restoring visible focus

**Severity P3.** Source/owner: `src/lib/components/GamePresets.svelte:143-160,174-176,234-280`.

**Repro:** Keyboard-focus Save preset, open its form, save `WaveOne Full Setup`; then focus Rename, open it, focus Cancel and activate it. **Expected:** after form unmount, focus returns to the created preset or the appropriate surviving tool/opener. **Actual:** autofocus correctly enters the name field, but both save and rename-cancel leave **document.activeElement=BODY**, with no focused visible control. A subsequent CDP Tab can reach Rename; **this is loss of immediate focus, not a claim that Tab is permanently blocked or restarts at page top**.

**Fix:** capture the appropriate surviving focus destination and focus it after the mode change/render tick, consistently for save/rename/cancel. **Regression:** save new/full/rules/group, rename/cancel/delete, pointer versus keyboard, removed/replaced opener. Preserve the current successful apply/off behavior and draft semantics.

### W1-08 — Primary navigation exposes no current-page/section state

**Severity P2 accessibility.** Source/owner: `src/App.svelte:64-70,105-117,128-130,225`.

**Repro:** Navigate to Players, History or Stats and inspect the visible primary links; repeat mobile and desktop. **Expected:** the visually active destination also exposes its current-page/section state to assistive technology. **Actual:** Players receives `class=active`, but **aria-current is null on every navigation link**. **Fix:** bind appropriate `aria-current` semantics to the existing active map; distinguish exact current pages from section hubs on drill-in routes rather than falsely declaring a hub the exact current URL. **Regression:** all four hubs and grouped drill-ins, mobile/desktop, no current marker on inactive links; existing route focus and visuals unchanged. Distinct from stateful editor-button findings/#234/W4-SC03.

### W1-09 — Shared BackLink is explicitly shorter than the product's 46px target floor

**Severity P3.** Source/owner: `src/lib/components/BackLink.svelte:10-23`.

**Repro:** Measure Back to Games on Browse/Tally/Hearts or Back to Stats on Court. **Expected:** interactive height >=46 CSS px per root product constraint. **Actual:** shared `.backlink` specifies min-height44px and renders **44px** at320/390/1280 in both themes (Games width79.98px, Stats67.38px). This is a measured repository-floor violation, **not a claim that44px violates WCAG's24px target minimum**.

**Fix:** correct the shared minimum to46px without changing breadcrumb presentation/navigation. **Regression:** all BackLink consumers, keyboard focus, themes and widths. Count once; **not** `.btn.small`/#235 or social-editor local controls/#242.

### W1-10 — Enabled player choices silently do nothing at the selection limit

**Severity P3.** Source/owner: `src/lib/components/PlayerSelect.svelte:15-30,36-43`.

**Repro:** On Tally with14 active synthetic players, select12, then activate another unselected player. **Expected:** a reached limit is explicitly communicated or unavailable choices are semantically disabled; selected choices must remain deselectable. **Actual:** both remaining choices are **disabled=false**, but the toggle's guarded branch silently ignores activation.
